pilot_tenants: UNSELECTED: one existing HCM design-partner tenant; tenant name and sponsor require commercial approval
pilot_selection_criteria: Select one tenant with a named executive sponsor, an operational HCM collaboration use case, and a product owner who can establish the workflow baseline.
Require signed participation, data-processing and retention terms; supported identity lifecycle; named tenant administrator and incident contact; and an agreed exit/export path.
Use a bounded pilot cohort with employee representatives and accessible desktop/mobile web coverage; do not enable tenant-wide access by default.
Keep cross-company chat grants CHAT-012 and cross-company document grants HUB-015 disabled in this proposed first pilot. Select a two-tenant cohort only after a separate bilateral gate is approved.

slos.name: durable message send
slos.target: Candidate: p99 committed-send latency <= 1 second; zero success acknowledgements without a durable chat-database commit. Measure under concurrent writers and retry load. The latency threshold borrows the suite's initial local-authoritative-command objective and needs Chat owner approval.

slos.name: interactive chat and documentation reads
slos.target: Candidate: p95 <= 500 ms for in-boundary reads, using the suite's initial interactive-projection objective; measure at pilot peak and obtain product/operations approval.

slos.name: search freshness
slos.target: Candidate: p95 index freshness lag <= 60 seconds, aligned with the suite's initial search-freshness objective; stale results must still pass current authorization checks.

slos.name: authorization revocation
slos.target: Candidate hard ceiling: invalidate active streams and deny subsequent history/media/document reads within 60 seconds of committed membership or identity revocation; test every served path. This adapts the suite's P0 termination-reconciliation objective and requires Security/Privacy approval.

slos.name: workflow isolation under mixed load
slos.target: Workflow wake-up p95 remains <= 5 seconds for due P0/P1 timers, and admission/start, approval latency, queue age and HCM transaction errors remain within a proposed <= 5% regression from the same workflow-only baseline during chat/document peak, reconnect, indexing and retention load. The 5% relative budget is a proposal requiring Operations and workflow-owner approval.

activation_conditions: A named design partner, target HCM collaboration workflow, baseline and adoption target, migration cost, equivalent displaced effort and funded capacity owner are approved in writing.

Named individuals accept product, engineering/on-call, Security/Privacy, Records/Search, and commercial/operations responsibilities; support hours, escalation route, incident owner, rollback, and export/exit runbook are exercised.

The pilot scope exchange and proposed SLO values are approved by required roles; P1A/P1B remain unchanged, and the CHAT-012/HUB-015 deferral is accepted or replaced by an explicit equivalent exchange.
Identity lifecycle, access checks, durable send, audit, retention/hold/export, documentation access, accessibility, recovery, and overload evidence pass their acceptance suites.
Mixed-tenant peak and failure-injection qualification meets every approved SLO for seven consecutive days; workflow-only baselines and chat/document load measurements are retained.
Only the selected pilot cohort is activated after the accountable Gate C release owner records a real decision and approval evidence.
deactivation_conditions: Immediately disable the affected tenant/cohort and preserve incident evidence on any confirmed cross-tenant or unauthorized disclosure, missing durable message behind a success acknowledgement, or inability to honor legal hold/retention policy.

Pause new invitations and writes if a required authorization revocation exceeds its approved ceiling, or if workflow wake-up exceeds its 5-second p95 objective or the approved regression budget for 15 consecutive minutes; restore only after owner review and a clean 60-minute observation window.

Roll back pilot activation if recovery/export cannot complete within the approved RTO, an on-call/incident route is unavailable, or the approved cost/capacity ceiling is exceeded for two consecutive daily reviews.
A tenant sponsor may request exit; revoke access, preserve required records, export the agreed evidence, and complete the documented tenant exit before closing the pilot.
unmet_gates: No product, engineering/operations, Security/Privacy, Records/Search or commercial signer has approved this draft; individuals remain unassigned.
No design partner, tenant, HCM use case, baseline, adoption target, migration cost or funded capacity source is selected.

The proposed displaced effort in CHAT-012/HUB-015 has no estimate and is not approved as equivalent capacity; CHAT-012 deferral conflicts with the current company-chat spec's cross-company first-release commitment and needs an explicit product decision.
Numeric chat latency, revocation and relative workflow-regression thresholds are proposals adapted from suite objectives, not measured or approved chat SLOs.
Chat and documentation blockers remain in their source specs, including identity lifecycle, records, cross-company policy, integration operations, recovery and mixed-load evidence.
This artifact authorizes no implementation promotion, tenant/pilot deployment or all-employee activation.

source_evidence.claim: CHAT-001 requires a signed exchange naming displacement, owners, pilot tenants, SLOs and activation conditions, and preserves P1A/P1B inventory.
The draft contract describes chat audience/types, documentation relationship, product boundaries and cross-company first-release intent.
The release-gap table leaves product proof, lifecycle, records, reliability, cross-company controls and integration operations unresolved.
The routing contract requires mixed-load measurement, workflow-only comparison and a measured regression budget before broad activation.
Documentation access is separately governed and cross-company document access is off by default.

Suite planning objectives include p95 <500 ms interactive reads, p99 <1 s local authoritative commit, p95 <60 s search freshness, P0 termination reconciliation under 60 s, and workflow wake-up p95 <=5 s; these are not contracted chat targets.
Gate C has no Phase 1 date or staffing commitment and is planned from Gate B operating evidence.
